reviews.x: I call this brush the miracle brush! My daughter has waist length hair and it gets very tangled. She used to cry everytime I'd brush it. The first time I used this brush on her hair, it was silky smooth in just a couple of minutes without one tear being shed! And let me tell you, her hair was very tangled the first time I tried it. My jaw dropped! She loves brushing her hair now.

I ordered a two pack of boar bristle brushes and received a two pack of plastic bristle brushes- no boar bristles at all. None, zero, nada.  The brushes were not the colors indicated either and took a very long time to arrive. A disappointment to me, but my daughter is enjoying the brushes. These are greatly misrepresented so don't order if you want boar bristle.

reviews.x: I should have known better.  The quality is cheap, the bristles were falling out of the one brush, and it is not cost effective to return them.... just spend a little more and buy something better.  Not worth it.

I loved this brush at first after a month an a half with normal use the top little black balls on top of the bristles started falling off it’s painful to use now sad face I will have to get another brush now and of course the return window is closed now!!!

My 7 yr old gets the worst knots and cries every single time I brush her hair, which leads us to avoid doing it. Her hair can take an hour to deal with due to crying, stopping, starting, crying again, and repeat. Not this brush. She had a massive back of the head knot and it was out in five minutes. No tears. I am floored by how great these brushes are.

This should have been a fake come-on product from China, cheaply made, with not quite English instructions. While it IS made in China, it’s sturdy enough and not at all overpriced. The surprising thing, though, is that it actually works! One swoop through my thick, shoulder-length sticky gray hair, and all the tangles are gone.

reviews.t: My wife and kids love them!
reviews.x: Works really well!  Both of my grade school daughters' long hairs constantly get tangled up and my wife spent hours trying to smooth them out practically every week.  It was painful for the girls and tiring for my wife.  With these new brushes it's so easy that the girls themselves can painlessly smooth out their own hair every morning.  No fuzz at all.

I have bought so many brushes trying to find one that works well for my curly hair that gets bad tangles and “rats nests” often. My niece (who has similar hair as mine) recommended this brush so I tried it. Wow! It works better than anything I have owned and causes very little pain when brushing this mess out! I will always own one of these brushes!

It’s a great brush, but it needs to be a tad bit tougher…. It combs, but when you need to get a tangle out, the bristles aren’t tough enough. I have to literally go get a different brush. This brush is very gentle. My daughter doesn’t complain…. But I need this to be just a bit stronger to get through the tangles. Not go get a different brush.

I purchased these because my daughter has very thick, long hair that gets tangled and brushing it out always resulted in tears - not with this brush! She doesn't fuss or try to run away anymore. Love this! It works great on her hair. I also use the 2nd one for myself and have to say that it does not pull at all, even with larger knots.

This brush was purchased for our 3yr old, she has crazy curly hair and always hated to have her hair brushed because it hurt and we also had to use a lot of hair product. Now, we use very little product and she no longer runs from having her hair brushed. I recommend this brush for anyone with curly or unruly hair.

reviews.t: One arrived used with hair in it.
reviews.x: Friends ordered these and they really WORK! But now I have to go out of my way to return and wait on a reorder because they sent one that had obviously been used - no packaging and had someone’s hair in it. A hassle. We were really excited for these and wanted to use them right away!

reviews.t: Great hair brushes that my granddaughters love to use
reviews.x: I bought these for my granddaughter that has long curly hair. She hated combing and brushing her hair because it always pulled her hair and her curls, until I bought her this brush.  I gave the second one to my other granddaughter that is 5 yrs old and she loves it also.

Wow!!! I have always had super thick long hair. I can brush right through my wet hair, no pain and pulling hair out. Wish this was around when I was a child, getting my hair brushed would have been nothing. Highly recommend for children and adults

reviews.t: easy to use to straighten long knotted hair
reviews.x: my youngest has long hair and often knotted.  This brush does the trick and doesn't pull her hair out nor cause too much pain.  I don't know how this works but it does.  Might take a little longer than other brushes but this way is painless

It has been a challenge to find a brush or comb that is comfortable and not destructive for my curly hair. This is now my favorite brush in the world. It didn't tug or rip the snarls and detangled my hair in one easy pass. Thank you!!!!!

I was very skeptical but thought I'd try it. It does what it says. It pulls through the tangle with little or no pull. They're wonderful. I used one for a 4 year old that doesn't like her hair brushed and now she brushes it.

These made brushing my Granddaughter's here so much easier on both of us! Her hair is very fine and prone to snarling, these somehow get through the snatls without pulling at them, so thankful that I found out about them.

These brushes work so well. I can brush my granddaughter’s hair without them screaming and crying that it hurts. I don’t know how the brush works but it just glides through the tangles leaving behind smooth shiny hair.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the brush detangles even severe knots painlessly, especially for children's long or curly hair.
Several reviewers report poor durability, with bristles or the little balls on the tips falling out.
Some reviewers say the bristles are too soft to work through tougher tangles.
A few reviewers complain the product did not match the description, including missing boar bristles and wrong colors.
